context.body: Bones, descendants, and later memory · Wisdom 10:13–14
context.label: Bones, descendants, and later memory

observations.body: The retelling follows a righteous man through sale, dungeon, bonds, royal authority, false accusation, and enduring glory while making wisdom the continuing actor.
observations.label: Wisdom retells the sold righteous man without naming Joseph

observations.body: The passage presents A righteous man is sold, confined, vindicated, and raised to authority as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: A righteous man is sold, confined, vindicated, and raised to authority

observations.body: The passage places Joseph is recalled without his personal name beside A righteous man is sold, confined, vindicated, and raised to authority.
observations.label: Joseph is recalled without his personal name

payload.posture: Read Wisdom 10:13–14 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The retelling attributes continuous action to wisdom
payload.title: Wisdom retells the sold righteous man without naming Joseph
